title: check flags an open item whose repro or checks name a moved file or select no test
goal: backlog.py check warns of an open item whose repro or checks read a repository path that is gone (offline and fast), and kb-sprint plan runs `backlog.py selectors`, which names a -k selector that collects no test; so a split or a drop does not leave items that can never finish. Answers BG-57n4r577 (a repro reading a moved test file) and ST-tbi3rras (checks of a dropped task).
